title: Good snacks, but a little disappointed with my first order (duplicates)
text: My mom got me a box of the vegan snacks for Christmas, and I really enjoyed the variety so I thought I would sign up for a subscription. I just received my first box, and I have to say I'm a little disappointed, because I received duplicate snack items for 2 things. They were nuts/seeds so it wasn't super exciting anyway, but now I have two. I'll give it another month to see if the duplicates was a one time thing, but otherwise I'm going to cancel. It's not a cheap subscription box, and I wanted it for the variety.
label: neutral
